name: application-scroll-area
title: Scroll Area
description: Custom-styled scrollable containers with a slim themed scrollbar for lists, feeds, and horizontal chip rows in web applications.
useWhen: Custom-styled scrollable containers with a slim themed scrollbar for lists, feeds, and horizontal chip rows in web applications.
avoidWhen: Avoid scroll area when a simpler pattern communicates the same content or action.
responsiveBehavior: Scroll Area uses responsive Tailwind utilities where present. Test its layout and interaction states at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths before shipping.
accessibility: Provide meaningful alternative text for informative images and empty alt text for decorative images.
Keep semantic HTML structure and visible text labels when adapting this component.
Preserve the component’s semantic HTML when adapting its visual treatment.
